notes.title: Major Update #5 - Migrated the game to a newer engine version
notes.content: [p][b]We’ve finally migrated the game to a newer engine version. Thanks to this, [i]nircmd[/i] and the extra executable file are no longer needed to run the game on 10th-gen Intel CPUs and newer.[/b][/p][p][b] In addition, we did everything on the list below:[/b]  [/p][p][/p][h3]Day-Night Cycle & Random Weather Variation[/h3][list][*][p]Added a dynamic weather system with snow and fog.[/p][/*][*][p]Added snowflake effects on the locomotive’s front windows during snowfall.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the sun’s movement across the sky, improving sunrise and sunset positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted day-night lighting.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p][b]Simulator Mode: [/b]flashlights are now available for purchase in shops.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Survival Mode[/b]: introduced a new weapon, the [b]RPG-7[/b]. You can find it in a special location near Izhmorskaya station. (It’s not yet available in Story Mode).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Survival Mode[/b]: new explorable locations. You can find ammunition in these new areas:[/p][list][*][p]Abandoned Military Base (between Anzherskaya and Sudzhenka)[/p][/*][*][p]Old Factory (Izhmorskaya)[/p][/*][*][p]Yuri Ivankov’s House (Antibesskaya)[/p][/*][*][p]Abandoned Building (Suslovo)[/p][/*][*][p]Barrack (between Bogotol and Vagino)[/p][/*][*][p]Abandoned Department Store (Chernorechenskaya)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Significantly improved performance of the Measurement Apparatus illumination.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimised Buffer Lights and flashlights.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall lighting performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the police would never stop chasing you.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the glass could clip into the camera while drinking at the bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of navigation-system-related crashes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’re heading back to work on the continuation of [b]Story Mode[/b] and have further optimisation plans in the pipeline. Thanks for your support![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_2enzqUvx5Q;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="38SMZ9u2zbU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Update #4 - Added about 190 km of route.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added about 190 km of route from Achinsk to Krasnoyarsk. The route is available in all game modes.
[*]New locations have been added on the section from Yashkino to Anzherskaya, where indestructible locomotive parts can be obtained in Survival mode. In Story mode, these parts are not yet available.
[*]In Simulator mode, indestructible locomotive parts can be purchased in hangars along the route from Yashkino to Krasnoyarsk.
[*]New NPCs armed with AK rifles have been added, appearing in some of the new locations.
[*]Fixed a bug where replacing the "Leaf spring" did not repair the train's condition.
[*]Fixed a bug where some "Journal box lead" parts did not affect the train's condition.
[*]Fixed a bug where an item in the inventory would disappear when pressing Esc while moving it.
[*]Fixed several very rare crashes.
[*]Fixed several places where the minimap in the train was not working correctly.
[*]Improved performance around the alcohol warehouse.
[*]Improved forest performance.
[*]Adjusted AI trains at several stations to reduce instances where they would follow and collide with the player.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update #3 - Added about 190 km of route.
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Added about 190 km of route from Suslovo to Achinsk. The route is available in all game modes.[/b]
[/list]

We are continuously working on the continuation of the story mode, but it will take a little more time to complete. Thank you for purchasing our game and for all the positive reviews. We really appreciate it.

notes.title: Update 27.11.2024
notes.content:
[list]

[*]Improved overall game optimization, especially in areas with a high density of trees.
[*]Reduced the game's size by approximately 5 GB.
[*]Decreased the frequency of overly long transport tasks in favor of shorter ones.
[*]Fixed a bug with the "Vodka Connoisseur" achievement, where drinking vodka in bars wasn’t being counted.
[*]Fixed a bug where four journal box leads did not wear out. 
[*]Fixed a bug in the laboratory mission where the mission could not be completed if a scientist died before entering the laboratory area.
[*]Adjusted the aggression of scientists in the laboratory to ensure they only attack when you are on their territory.
[*]Fixed the "Pole Dancer" achievement. Now, kills outside the club no longer affect it.
[*]Fixed the battery handle saving issue.
[*]Fixed the issue with using the signalization direction handle when playing with a gamepad.

[/list]

We are continuously working on optimization and the continuation of the story mode. Expect the opening of another big route section in December. The continuation of the story mode will take a bit more time. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Update 17.10.2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed numerous keyboard control issues in the menu.
[*]Added support for Xbox controller.
[*]Added a default save name when creating a new save.
[*]Added a default game name when starting a new game.
[*]Fixed a bug where clicking on the inventory background made it impossible to close.
[*]Added the ability to focus on levers by holding the right mouse button, allowing control with the scroll wheel without having to hide the inventory.
[*]Fixed a bug where mouse sensitivity in inspect mode did not affect the camera rotation speed.
[*]Corrected the time calculation for achieving Swiss Cheese.
[*]Fixed a bug where the number of FPS affected the rotation speed of held items.
[/list]

[b]Update 18.10.2024[/b]

[*]Fixed a bug with changing the language during the game's first launch. (Yesterday's update caused this problem).
[*]Added changes to the pressure system to allow proper use of the locomotive with the small compressor turned off after it was previously started.
[*]Adjusted the color scheme of parts in inspect mode so that their color better reflects their current condition.

notes.title: Major Update #2 - Added over 200 km of route.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added over 200 km of route from Yashkino to Suslovo. 
[*]Added Steam achievements. Mafia mission achievements will be retroactively granted to players who have completed them and load the appropriate save.
[*]Added bulletproof locomotive glass. You can find them in the hangars behind the Yashkino station.
[*]Fixed a bug where having a weapon in hand allowed stealing from the junkyard without being detected.
[*]Improved loading of shooting NPCs who can run. 
[*]Enabled Steam Cloud
[/list]

notes.title: Update 28.08.2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The timing of the repair of the destroyed bridge was changed so that after the bridge is blown up before Tutal'skaya station, you can connect the wagons and transport them across the bridge.
[*]Fixed the railway wagons disconnection area at Bolotnoye station, where wagons could not be delivered correctly if they were positioned at the end of the area. 
[*]Changed the currency from Dollars to Rubles.
[*]Added backlighting to the speedometer.
[*]Reduced the movement speed of the character inside the locomotive to make it smoother.
[*]Added more shooting NPCs who move around; some stationary shooting NPCs now also move.
[*]Decreased NPC shooting accuracy.
[*] Balanced the rewards for some mafia missions.
[*] Improved the spawn of AI trains when traveling the same route multiple times.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update #1 - Endless Transport Tasks
notes.content:
[b]Endless Transport Tasks and Minimap Added:[/b]

[list]
[*]Upon reaching a train station, you will receive a message from the dispatcher about available transport tasks.
[*]You can check the available transport tasks in your area by making radio calls.
[*]At most stations, there are at least 2 different tasks available, involving transport in both directions.
[*]Tasks are randomly generated and endless.
[*]Initially, to ensure financial liquidity, tasks involve shorter routes. After passing through 19 stations, tasks involving longer routes are generated.
[*]You are not obliged to complete transport tasks.
[*]We have removed time limits for completing transport tasks.
[*]If you disconnect wagons in the wrong place, they will disappear and the task will be canceled. (Remember to park wagons in designated zones). 
[*]The task's value is determined based on the length of the route needed to deliver the wagons.
[*]The destination station and task value are displayed on the waypoint.
[*]If you start the game from an old save with an active transport task, you must complete that task to receive new tasks under the new rules.
[*]If a new game is started with a tutorial, new tasks will appear only after its completion.
[*]Currently, only one transport task can be taken at a time.
[*]We added a minimap that allows you to check how long a route you need to travel to complete a specific task.
[*]The minimap is automatically available upon entering the locomotive, and to scroll it, you can enter the inventory.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=E-ZiHUCMtz4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Bugs:[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the second section of the locomotive to stop working after loading the game when the panel blocker key was installed
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a planted explosive to disappear when loaded on a bridge.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the militiaman to whom you must deliver the camera to stop working if he was in the middle of dialogue when loading a save.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused AI trains to derail at the Novosibirsk-Glavny station.
[*]Fixed the flashlight zoom bug. 
[/list]

[b]Other Features:[/b]

[list]
[*]The radio in the second section of the locomotive is now fully functional.
[*]Blown-up bridges are automatically repaired after moving away from them.
[*]We improved the railroad switch highlighting system, so irrelevant switches will no longer be highlighted.
[*]The direction shown for the nearest important points is now based on which cabin the panel blocker key is in.
[*]The dispatcher is now a real human.
[/list]
[b]Thank you for purchasing our game and for the many positive reviews! It really motivates us to keep working. Meanwhile, we are getting to work on the next updates. See you soon![/b]

notes.title: Update 25.06.2024
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug where the locomotive save would not load correctly after moving several kilometers away from it.

- We have mostly restored the division of game files into smaller elements to minimize the required disk space during game updates.

Info: We are still working on making transport tasks offered randomly in both directions to make gameplay more freeform and increase the game's replay value. Our goal is also to have a selection field for transport tasks at train stations to give you as much freedom as possible. 
Implementing these changes will take about a month. During this time, we will also address the most critical bugs in parallel. After all this, we will make another route length available. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Update 21.06.2024
notes.content:
- In the second section of the locomotive, there is no longer a need to turn off the lights and heaters to remove the panel blocker key.
- Lights and heaters now operate independently for each section of the locomotive.
- The lights and heaters are now powered by the battery.
- Buffer red lights can now be turned on independently of the buffer white lights.
- The lights in the second section of the locomotive now shine with the same intensity as those in the first section.
- Brakes are no longer dependent on the compressor and use pressure from the main reservoir.
- The compressor pumps pressure in the main reservoir up to 9.2 kg, then shuts off and turns back on at 7 kg.
- Fixed the bug where the pressure in the main reservoir would not drop.
- Setting the main brake handle to the release and charge position no longer fills the main reservoir.
- Removed the sign to lower the pantographs just before Oyash station to avoid conflict with the red light.
- Saving the game while the locomotive was on a switch caused the locomotive to disappear when loading that save in a newer version of the game. This bug has been fixed. It will work for saves made in the new version of the game. If someone saved the train on a switch and lost the locomotive upon loading before this update, they should load their previous save. (Probably an autosave). 
- Fixed the bug that caused the game time in saves to be counted incorrectly
- Fixed the bug that caused loading a save from the main menu and the end-game menu to not work with a double click of the left mouse button or by pressing enter..
- Fixed the bug that caused a red light to display when it should be yellow.
- Fixed the bug with the NPC who would not buy weapons at Novosibirsk-Glavny station. 
- Some localization fixes.

notes.title: Update 14.06.2024
notes.content:
- Added the ability to sell weapons. You can find the right people in bars and shops.
- Once again, we've slowed down the wear of locomotive parts.
- Increased the maximum speed of the locomotive to 100 km/h in zones with a 60 km/h speed limit and to 70 km/h in zones with a 40 km/h speed limit. Exceeding these maximum speeds will result in derailment. When you exceed speed limits (40, 60), locomotive parts wear out faster. 
- Fixed the bug causing desynchronization of level state saves, which among other things, caused the locomotive to disappear after exiting the night club. This will work from new saves onwards.

If anyone wants to send us saves with bugs, they are now located in a new location:
C:\Users{YourWindowsUserName}\AppData\Local\Train\Saved\SaveGames\Game

notes.title: Update 11.06.2024
notes.content:
- Reduced the number of AI trains running on the same track. 
- Added some localization fixes.
- Improved waypoint display.
- Reduced the wear of heaters and speedometer by 100%. 
- Fixed the bug with the invisible field current indicator.
- Fixed the bug that caused the jump button change to not work properly. (If someone changed it, it needs to be changed again).

notes.title: Update 7.06.2024
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug causing visual artifacts in the locomotive after lowering the pantographs with 'Projector Light' turned on.
- We slowed down the bulb wear rate by 100%.  Let us know if it's still too fast.
- We increased the flashlight power. 

Thank you very much for your activity on the forum and for helping each other out!  It really helps us save time and focus on improving the game.

notes.title: Update 6.06.2024
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug with the highlighting of the "Coupler lever." Now, when disconnecting wagons, the correct  lever are highlighted.
- Improved the transport task system to avoid situations where disconnecting wagons in the designated area did not count towards the task. Unfortunately, due to the nature of this bug, we have not been able to fix it for already corrupted save files.
- Bug with disappearing locomotive - it turned out that the source of the bug was a major issue with the world save system. We have overhauled it to a more reliable system, but if the problem persists, we will have to make even deeper changes to the saving system. We apologize for the inconvenience. 
- Fixed the bug that caused the tutorial to break after reaching the first signs without skipping the last tutorial information after connecting the wagons, making it impossible to deliver the wagons. Unfortunately, currently, corrupted save files will not be fixed upon loading.
- If someone couldn't continue the mission in the night club due to the missing suitcase, they can now do so. We have implemented a temporary solution for situations where players replaying the game could load a previously played version of the club upon entering. A complete solution to the problem will be added at a later time.
- Fixed the bug where wagons appeared twice in the same place, creating the impression of clipping through each other. Unfortunately, currently, this will not be fixed in save files where it has already happened.
- Fixed several situations where wagons to be picked up were not in place. Save files with this situation should be fixed. 
- We have already found a solution to the problem of visual artifacts in the locomotive after lowering the pantographs with "Projector Light" turned on, and we will add it in the next update.

notes.title: Update 2.06.2024
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug with the locomotive derailing after loading the game.
- The bug with the locomotive state resetting after exiting the night club should be fixed.

We apologize for the few fixes, but the above issues took us a lot of time.

notes.title: Update 1.06.2024
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug with the disappearing locomotive.
- Fixed the crash after leaving the night club. 
- If there are no railway wagons to pick up, they should now appear. We tested it on the saves you sent us. Thank you!

After the last update, we noticed that some players experienced crashes when starting a new game, and possibly also when loading a saved game. In such cases, please verify integrity of game files. 

Players without a 10th gen Intel processor or newer who cannot launch the game through Steam can go to the game folder and launch it directly via the .exe file.

notes.title: Update 31.05.2024
notes.content:
- Fixed the respawning of NPCs after loading the game who had previously died. This will work on new saves.
- Fixed dead animals often falling under the map after loading, which we believe was causing crashes after leaving the night club.
- Fixed crashes after leaving the club, at least we hope so. We are about 90% sure that the changes we made to the code will prevent crashes from saves.
- if there are no railway wagons to pick up, they will try to respawn, which should work.
- Fixed the bug with the disappearing locomotive.

If any of the above issues persist, please let us know!

 We are continuously analyzing your reported problems and striving to ensure the game runs stable. This is our plan for the near future, so expect frequent updates. As soon as we deal with the bugs, we will start updating with new content. 

[b]Thank you for purchasing our game and for the many positive reviews![/b]ːsteamthumbsupː

If you haven't done so yet, get to it!

notes.title: UPDATE 8.11.2022
notes.content:
The game has been tested by professionals. We received an extensive feedback. The most important thing is that the game is stable and optimal and there are no major bugs, but it still needs some balance of the gameplay. Due to the fact that the game area is often forested, we have to fill it with more survival events. I think the next round of testing will take place in a few weeks. When we get the green light, we will release a free demo. If the demo gets good reviews then we will release early access to continue working on developing the game with your help. 

I will continue to keep you posted on the progress in this topic: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/998400/discussions/0/3480742287614079829/

notes.title: News
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 

It's been a while. We just would like to confirm that the game is still in development. 
What is stage of production? We hope it will light things up a little.
We are polishing different mechanics, fixing bugs, optimizing, implementing gameplay, coding save system, and working on AI animals and people. 
As you can see we still have some work left. What we've done so far?
[b]SIMULATOR MODE[/b] is close to be ready. It contains currently: 
- Open World map from Novosibirsk to Krasnoyarsk. About 800 km, real scale and real train stations with interiors
- Driving simulation, you have to follow the railway signs and light signalling to avoid problems
- Locomotive repairing system that is linked to section mode. You can change locomotive parts and control their condition during the trip
- Railway wagons system, Simple AI, radio, tools and shops

In parallel, we are working on a [b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b] which still requires more time to spend. 
It contains everything above and additionally:
- Survival system with hunger, thirst, alcohol, hangover, illness, hypotermia and fatigue stats. 
- Advanced AI people, guns, corrupt police officers
- Buy/Sell system
- Smuggling system with mafia 
- AI animals, hunting system, and more.

We do our best to finish the game as quick as possible but we have to be sure that we will provide you a good quality product. We appreciate that you are waiting. Thank you for your patient.

We have a small video that shows some basic mechanics. Enjoy!

Pentacle
